decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - Installation of new shop front and internal alterations would be acceptable because of their position, design and appearance, and would not harm the appearance of street scene.  The development is in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B 1.4 (Advertisements) and S.4.3 (Advertisements) of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and the Council's Shop Fronts and Think Access Guidelines.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)
description: Installation of new shop front and internal alterations.
